details.publicNotes:
Curselings pose as magic items to trick hapless explorers into donning them. Once equipped, they dutifully provide magic benefits, while secretly injecting their eggs into their wearer's bloodstream.

A beastmaster's curseling has a beastmaster's helm as its default form. Other curselings have their own default forms.

Curseling Varieties

Curselings always appear as invested magic items that grant an item bonus to a skill. While most curselings can grant a +1 item bonus, curselings exposed to potent surges of magic occasionally mutate into stronger forms that gain combat prowess and can reshape into higher-level items. In general, much like the beastmaster's helm, these items should be a bit more versatile than normal for items of their level, and unavailable through other means. There's nothing worse for a curseling than to be tossed into a spacious pouch with the other items that "might be useful someday."

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 5/12/22 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing), armor (medium, heavy), perception item, skill items (Athletics, Lore [Magic Item])

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, burning barbs, constitution, dexterity, energy resistant (fire, vitality), fire, fire shield, mind, mind shield, poison, poisonous armor, sensory (darkvision), wild, wisdom

description.value: This skill pertains to magic items, both knowing about what types of magic exist and Identifying Magic to determine the properties of magic items.

When a creature invests a curseling that is using item mimicry, the curseling injects the creature with its egg-laden venom. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save. The creature only notices the injection on a critical success.

Curseling Venom (curse, mental, poison)

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 The curseling establishes a mystical bond to its wearer. The wearer becomes unwilling to remove the item, even during circumstances like bathing or sleeping where keeping the item on is unusual. Removing the item forcefully requires a successful Athletics check against the higher of the curseling's Fortitude DC and the wearer's Fortitude DC and deals @Damage[1d8[persistent,bleed]] damage to the wearer. Removing the curseling at this stage breaks the curse. (1 week)

Stage 2 As stage 1, but removing the curseling no longer breaks the curse. It continues to take up an invested item slot and can choose to return to the wearer 24 hours later. The wearer develops a compulsion to hoard metal. (1 week)

Stage 3 The creature is compelled to gather its metal hoard and then seek out a fire to fall asleep next to. If it falls asleep next to a fire, its body explodes in flames and juvenile curselings emerge from its corpse (1 week).

The curseling takes the form of a magic item. It can be worn and invested, granting the item's usual benefits. As long as the curseling remains perfectly still, its identity is difficult to discern. Using Identify Magic to recognize a curseling requires a critical success. By default, a beastmaster's curseling takes the form of its own bespoke magic item called a beastmaster's helm.

A beastmaster's helm appears to be an uncommon primal invested 4th-level item with — Bulk. While wearing this helm on its head, a creature gains a +1 item bonus to Nature checks, which increases to +2 for Nature checks to Command an Animal, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to Initiative rolls. The wearer can also use Animal Speech once per hour.

Animal Speech 2 (concentrate, manipulate, primal)

The wearer can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals for 1 minute.

By spending 1 week reshaping its form, the beastmaster's curseling can reforge itself into the cursed version of a common worn and invested magic item of level 4 or lower that grants a +1 item bonus to a skill, or back from one of these forms into its beastmaster's helm form.
The curseling pulls its body into its protective item shell. It gains Hardness 3, which lasts until it spends an action with the move or attack trait.
